Tool: built-in image_gen (transparent_background: true)

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production environment prop sprite atlas for an original mature 2.5D dark fantasy action RPG.
Create ONE horizontal sprite sheet with EXACTLY FOUR EQUAL COLUMNS and ONE ROW, ideal aspect 4:1 and 2048x512 pixels. Invisible square cells, ONE complete isolated prop inside EACH cell. This is a real game asset atlas, not a presentation or concept art page. All four props use the SAME fixed orthographic camera looking down at 45-50 degrees, facing the same direction, showing tops, front and right sides. Same warm top-front-left key light, cool deep shadows, muted charcoal / aged brass / stone palette, meticulous hand-painted pre-rendered gritty medieval fantasy material detail. Crisp cutout silhouettes and excellent readable volume. NOT chibi, NOT cartoon, NOT plastic low-poly.
Four distinct objects, EXACT order left to right:
1. A gothic carved stone filing sarcophagus / archive cabinet, a tall substantial dark basalt stone chest with pointed-arch relief panels and heavy BLACK IRON CHAINS wrapped around it. A FEW faded yellow rolled case files and old folios rest on top. Fantastical medieval archive storage, not modern office furniture. Complete top and carved stone feet.
2. An ancient dark oak council altar table, broad rectangular heavy timber with richly carved legs. An open briefing codex, a modest stack of old pages, a torn violet cloth draped over one corner, melted ivory wax and a short candle stump on the tabletop. A believable functional medieval table, with complete feet visible.
3. An imposing executive throne in blackened wood and black iron, restrained antique gold carvings, dark burgundy velvet seat/back, worn feather details, a narrow integrated rack holding a scroll / document-shaped ceremonial scepter. Rich throne volume and readable seat; all feet and full back crown included. No person.
4. A tall gothic stone shrine / niche, including a small weathered winged stone statue, architectural pointed arch, built-in iron candleholders, a few very dim candle flames, hanging torn cloth. Fully visible monument from its topmost wings / finials down to its stone pedestal. No separate floor slab extending into adjacent cells.
Atlas packing constraints: every object must remain COMPLETELY inside its own equal cell, generous transparent padding at least 8% on LEFT and RIGHT, at least 6% above. No object or loose page crosses into a neighboring cell. All props stand on an identical bottom contact baseline at 92% of cell height; center their bases horizontally. Keep physically believable relative proportions: table lower than throne and shrine; do not elongate the table just to fill its square.
Backdrop MUST BE GENUINELY TRANSPARENT ALPHA. Clean anti-aliased edges colored from the subject itself; no red matte fringe, no gray matte fringe, no colored halos. Absolutely NO ground, NO floor, NO terrain tile, NO cast shadow, NO contact shadow, NO smoky background, NO ambient fog, NO black rectangle, NO checkerboard texture. Do not add UI, borders, dividers, labels, text, writing glyphs, logos, watermarks, or extra objects outside the four props. Only four isolated, highly detailed gothic environment objects.
